item.description: About HumLUG: The Humboldt Linux Users Group is a group of individuals in the Humboldt County area that enjoy the use of Linux and discussions about technology. We enjoy meeting and being able to spend time with interesting people who share our interests and the opportunity to learn new things.

Announcements: Next Thursday Evening Presentation Meeting: Next meeting: 6:00PM Jan 15, 2026 at the Babe’s Pizza conference room This month’s HumLUG presentation meeting will cover three awesome topics: see events The site has been moved to it’s new home The site has been moved to a new github repo and is now ready for new contributors for anyone who wants to help update it.

HumLUG Events: Lunch meetings: HumLug meets for lunch and fun discussions about technology every friday at 11:30am at Babe’s Pizza in Eureka. Evening meetings: We have monthly presentation focussed meetings on the third Thursday at 6:00PM at Babe’s Pizza in Eureka. Next meeting: 6:00PM May 21th, 2026 at the Babe’s Pizza conference room Dave Rowe will give a project update on his Raspberry Pi Zero W portable file server project that uses copyparty as a lightweight file server.
